# Test Data Index

- `docs/locale_binary_format.md` - locale `.tla` binary format description
- `docs/testdata/i18n_en_v1.tla` - English locale sample
- `docs/testdata/i18n_en_gb_v1.tla` - British English locale sample with fallback locale `en`
- `docs/testdata/i18n_invalid_magic.tla` - invalid locale payload used by negative tests
- `docs/testdata/audio/README.md` - AudioKit sample overview
- `docs/testdata/audio/audio_known_16bit_mono.wav` - tiny PCM reference clip
- `docs/testdata/audio/audio_noise_tone.wav` - longer PCM clip
- `docs/testdata/audio/audio_tone.mp3` - MP3 test sample
- `docs/testdata/audio/audio_noise_tone.ogg` - OGG test sample
- `docs/testdata/audio/audio_invalid_magic.bin` - invalid audio payload used by negative tests
